skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic knowledge of e-commerce operation management, including product management, quality management, supply chain management, inventory management, and customer relationship management.
Analyze macro and micro environmental factors affecting e-commerce operations and predict market demand.
Identify and analyze risks in e-commerce purchasing processes and develop preventive measures.
Evaluate, classify, and manage human resources in e-commerce operations.
Solve problems and manage e-commerce operations effectively.
Work independently and collaboratively in e-commerce operations.
Analyze and evaluate business data to solve practical problems in e-commerce operations.
Demonstrate professional responsibility, creativity, and teamwork in e-commerce operations.
